summary: Runtime dependency pulled from unpinned third-party GitHub fork
details: package.json declares the runtime dependency `libsignal` with source `github:RahmadTenpoles/libsignal-node` — a bare GitHub ref with no commit SHA, tag, or integrity hash. On `npm install`, this resolves to whatever the default branch of that fork currently returns, including any lifecycle scripts the fork ships, and executes them on the installer's machine. The fork replaces the standard libsignal-node registry package used by upstream Baileys and is owned by a third-party account unrelated to the declared publisher, so whoever controls that GitHub repository controls code that runs at install time against every consumer of this package. The content delivered can change at any time without any republish of raiden-baileys.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
